styles.name: Data Pebble
styles.coreTrick: Every quantity is drawn as a smooth closed 8-point blob whose AREA (not width) equals the value, on a pale ground tinted from the brand hue, with white 18px cards carrying big light serif lining figures and a contrast-clamped deep primary.
styles.colourRecipe: Primary is re-printed as a 'deep pebble tone': saturation = clamp(s*0.85, 24, 58), then lightness stepped (light mode: start at min(L,28) and darken until white text holds 7:1; dark mode: start at L72 and lighten up to 90 until 7:1 on the ground). A muted or grey primary therefore still gets a forced 24% chroma in its own hue (no fixed fallback). Ground = low-chroma tint of the primary hue (light L93.5, dark L9.5; achromatic primary gets sat 3). Secondary only draws the comparison series (soft fill plus deeper edge); accent is one headline spark.

remainder.what: Contrast-search token derivation: muted text pulled toward ink in 0.1 steps until 4.6:1 on card, ground and inset surface; a separate 'muted on glass'; secondary edge stepped to 3.2:1; tag ink to 4.6:1
remainder.whyCode: iterative colour searches over several backgrounds; a generator would need a shared contrast-clamp primitive

remainder.what: Board hero art composition: a frosted card over a blurred pebble field; the cluster chart uses a hand-placed table of [name, now, before, x, y, seed, bx, by] and a hand-placed four-pebble background field
remainder.whyCode: bespoke chart layout with hand-tuned coordinates and per-datum copy

remainder.what: Hand-authored SVG data-URI masks for the five-pebble progress bar and the up/down pebble sparkline (shapes are baked paths, not generated)
remainder.whyCode: baked path data; could become a svg-generator output but today is a literal

remainder.what: Phone/Built overrides that retarget board components to kit selectors (.sb-k-*): the sparkline ::after on stat tiles, sidebar pills, avatar blobs, danger ring
remainder.whyCode: selector mapping to the shared kit DOM, data rather than logic but not expressible as palette moves

remainder.what: Deck materialArt specimens (stat tile + sparkline + pebble progress + frosted card) assembled from pebble generator calls
remainder.whyCode: hook returns bespoke markup

styles.notes: Pebble generator is deterministic from a seed (dpRand mulberry-style PRNG, js 40-49) so renders are stable. Frosted card and the blurred pebble field are board/website only; the style's own rule (js 295, css 13-15) bans decoration in app UI where pebbles are data only (sparkline, progress, row glyph).

styles.name: Dystopian Luxury
styles.coreTrick: Severity by removal: strip every card, shadow, radius and tint, then spend one oversized brand word cropped to its top 88% under a plain ink strip plus one blank accession label, and show the client primary exactly once per view as a 6px square before the action label.
styles.colourRecipe: Canvas is pushed to near-pure neutral (light: sat<=3, L>=97; dark: sat<=4, L<=5) and ink is near-black/near-white mixed 25-30% with the client ink. The client primary is never a fill: it is only a 6px square (--ab-dl-mark = t.primary, no fallback, a dull primary is still used). Secondary and accent appear only as 24px reference squares in the palette row. In the app kit primary, accent, secondary are all overridden to ink.

remainder.what: Word fit: measure the first brand word with a canvas 2D context at weight 800, scale it so its width is 102% of the board, cap at 64 (100 on narrow plates) and fall back to natural width for short words, then compute the crop strip y so 88% of the cap height shows
remainder.whyCode: runtime text measurement and per-brand sizing

remainder.what: Word split: break a long brand word (>=10 letters) near its middle at a consonant-consonant non-digraph boundary, else a vowel-consonant boundary, so two cropped plates stack on narrow boards
remainder.whyCode: string heuristic over the brand name

remainder.what: Hero re-grid: art wrapper and .dl-art set to display:contents so the plate runs edge to edge above the caption and the label; wide/narrow plates swapped by container query
remainder.whyCode: layout override of the shared hero grid; structural, not a visual parameter

remainder.what: Accession numbers: literal 'ITEM 01 / 2026.114.1' strings and CSS counters prefixed '2026.114.' injected via ::before on cards, rows and kit cells
remainder.whyCode: generated content tied to board DOM; text is data, the counter wiring is per-selector

remainder.what: Square-X stitch switch built from two 45deg conic-free linear gradients, and the 4-stitch label corners
remainder.whyCode: hand-drawn gradient glyphs, could be a css-recipe if the glyph set is in the library

styles.notes: The file also contains a '--classic' variant (css 317+); ignored per the brief. Header comment forbids classification text next to the brand name (js 8-10). The giant-word is the signature and is the part least reducible to params.

styles.name: Editorial Serif
styles.coreTrick: Set the page like a magazine: weight comes from contrast (400-weight serif, one italic accent word, small-caps sans labels) and structure from hairline and thick-over-thin rules on a cream-warmed paper canvas, with a duotone cover plate mixed from the primary as the only filled object.
styles.colourRecipe: Canvas (light only) is mixed toward cream: b.mix(b.canvas,'#f3ead9',0.74) (comment says ~25% toward cream; check mix() weight order). Primary fills only the one main action, the duotone plate (primary mixed 35% toward ink, so even a light or muted primary goes dark; a grey primary yields a grey plate, no chroma boost), the switch-on and the board tab underline. Pressed = mix(primary,#000,0.78) with readable text. Hover = ink background, canvas text. Accent is text only (accent-ink on the italic word and the section sign). Secondary tints small tags. In the kit everything except the one main action is ink (css 336-342).

remainder.what: Tracking multiplier --ab-tr from the heading face class (condensed 0, heavy 0, wide 0.4, techno 0.4, else 1) and the interface sans choice (the brand's own sans, else Inter): read from global state.headingFont/bodyFont
remainder.whyCode: reads the live font object (class and category) at render time; a move spec needs a font-class lookup primitive

remainder.what: Cover plate art markup: figure > plate with half-tone layer, grain layer, plate number, cropped initial, coverline and sub-line, plus figcaption with italic label and page number, all copy-driven with a {brand} placeholder
remainder.whyCode: art() hook returns bespoke markup; composable only if the library has a 'cover plate' template

remainder.what: Pull quote text lives as a literal in a CSS ::before content string and is only shown outside .sb-ab and .ab-slide
remainder.whyCode: fixed copy plus selector exclusions; not a palette or token move

remainder.what: Narrow and phone container-query re-layouts: masthead collapses to flex, hero to one column (plate to 4/4.6 under), palette to one column, list rows drop the leader at <=360px
remainder.whyCode: responsive layout rules specific to the board grid; recipe-able but per-breakpoint bespoke

remainder.what: Kit adapter: ~230 lines of selectors that map each shared-kit component class (.sb-k-*, .sb-tab, .ab-row.sb-k-row) to the editorial recipes; counters for 'No. NN' cell numbers; drop cap disabled on .ab-slide
remainder.whyCode: mostly mechanical (same few recipes applied to many selectors) but a class-selector map, so a move system needs a component-to-recipe table, not just recipes

styles.notes: REBUILD TABLE (exact values). Radii: 0 everywhere (board css 15, kit --k-r 0px css 341); only radio ring and skeleton avatar are round. Rules: --ab-hair = alpha(ink, 0.30 light / 0.26 dark); --ab-hair-soft = alpha(ink, 0.16 / 0.14); --ab-hair-strong = ink. Masthead rule = 7px tall: 3px strong on top + 1px strong at the foot (two 100% x 3px / 100% x 1px linear-gradient layers, css 37-41); kit reuses it as 3px solid top + 1px solid bottom on buttons, cards, menus, bars, cells; overlays 3px double. Plate: primary mix ink 0.35 (plate), mix black 0.5 (dark, unused in css), hi = mix(plate,canvas,0.3) light / mix(plate,ink,0.4) dark, lo = mix(plate,black,0.45) light / mix(plate,ink,0.25) dark; background = radial(90% 70% at 24% 14%, hi, transparent 62%) over linear(162deg, plate, lo); 1px strong border; halftone 5px grid, dot rgba(0,0,0,.75) 0.9-1.3px, opacity .34 (dark .16) multiply, mask 180deg transparent 20% to black 100%; grain 180px feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency .85, 2 octaves, opacity .09 multiply. Initial letter: heading face 400 uppercase, 150cqh, left -8%, bottom -38%, colour mix(plate 72%, canvas 28%). Plate box: width clamp(190px,29cqw,370px), aspect 3/4.15 (narrow 4/4.6). Headline: weight 400, size clamp(44px,11.5cqw,160px) x hl-scale x hs x display(1.22), line-height .94, tracking -0.028em x tr, balance wrap; narrow clamp(44px,17cqw,78px). Wordmark: uppercase 400, .05em x tr, clamp(20px,3cqw,34px). Dateline/tag 10.5px .16em uppercase muted; 'Vol. 01 · No. 1' is a ::before string. Kicker 11px 500 .22em ink with a flex hairline after. Standfirst clamp(16px,2cqw,23px)/1.38, max 30em, 1px hair top rule, padding-top clamp(12px,1.8cqw,20px). Section label 10.5px .16em 500; labelrow border-bottom 1px hair, pb 9px mb 18px; numerals heading italic 17px followed by ' — '. Palette: 5 cols, top 1px strong / bottom 1px hair, chips 18px square ringed 1px strong, role 10.5px 600 .14em caps, hex 11px tabular. Contents row: grid 3.4ch auto 1fr auto 5ch, row padding clamp(11px,1.5cqw,16px) 0, top 1px soft, name serif clamp(19px,2.3cqw,26px)/1.1 tracking -0.01em x tr, dotted 1px strong leader, status 10.5px .14em caps muted, pct italic 17px; type-pick counters start 12/24/38. Pull quote italic clamp(26px,4cqw,50px)/1.08, max 17em, centred, 1px strong top / 1px hair bottom. Card title clamp(28px,3.6cqw,42px)/1.02 tracking -0.02em x tr, body 17px/1.4 in 12.5em, drop cap 3.15em / line-height .8 / padding .05em .09em 0 0. Main action: padding 15px 18px, 11.5px 600 .18em uppercase, bg primary, hover bg ink / canvas text, active mix(primary,#000,.78) + translateY(1px), arrow '→' 15px. Field: underline 1px strong, italic heading 24px/1.2, label 10.5px 600 .18em caps; focus underline primary + 0 1px 0. Tabs: gap 26px, 11px 500 .16em caps muted, selected ink 600 + 2px primary underline (kit: 700 + 3px ink). Toggle: 40x18 square, inset 1px strong ring, 12px ink slug (kit 48x24 rule with 16px square slug). Kit: selection = ink text + 2-3px ink rule and italic title; pressed = ink fill reversed; focus = 2px ink outline offset 3px; disabled = dotted 3px/1px rules; checkbox = 22px 1px ink square with serif x (28px); radio = 22px ring 1.5px with 8px ink bullet; slider = 3px ink fill over 1px rule with 22px ink diamond; calendar: 3px/1px rules, serif 17px days, chosen day bold italic with inset 3px ink underline; cells numbered 'No. NN' italic 13px with 24px/28px serif name; accordion/menus hairline or dotted separators. Footer: 1px strong top, 11px .12em caps; motto italic 14px; dot replaced by serif '§' 15px in accent-ink. Unused tokens declared but not referenced in css I read: --ab-eds-plate-dark, --ab-eds-paper, --ab-eds-ink-hover.

styles.name: Frutiger Aero
styles.coreTrick: Every control is a vertical-gradient gel (lightness +34 / base / -9) with a white specular cap that ends in a crisp lower lip, built from the client primary lifted to candy chroma, sitting on near-opaque Aero glass with a hard 115deg gloss streak under a sky, hill and water scene where the headline is mirrored on a wet floor.
styles.colourRecipe: Primary is lifted to a candy gel: saturation floored at 55 when s>12 (below 12 stays grey), lightness clamped 40-62, then shaded down to L32 until white text reaches 4.5:1 (not for yellow hues 38-80) or lightened to L82 with the fixed dark label #0E2233. Companion gels are the primary's triad (+120, +240) and complement (+180) at saturation >=86, L52; an achromatic primary uses fixed candy greens/violet/orange. Secondary becomes the landscape: a green-ish hue (70-170, s>=18) is used as the hill, else fixed lime #7ED33F. Ink fixed #23415A (night #EAF5FF), canvas fixed #F2F7FB (night #071A2B), close button fixed red #D9442B.

remainder.what: Procedural scene: sky gradient, light rays, sparkles, lens-flare string, three rainbow swooshes with gloss lines, bokeh, clouds, hill with crest/foot, four rising orbs, water with mirrored primary orb, a 12-point 'new' seal, and a closing-slide strip SVG
remainder.whyCode: large hand-composed SVG scenes with night variant; only partly parameterised by the palette (colours), composition is bespoke. Internals of 195-345 skimmed, not read line by line

remainder.what: Gel label decision: choose white vs dark label by searching lightness so contrast >=4.5, with the dark label also checked on the darker base stop; pale companion tints found by walking lightness against the ink on both stops
remainder.whyCode: iterative colour searches (contrast-clamp)

remainder.what: Landscape test: use the secondary as the hill only when hue 70-170 and sat >=18, else the fixed lime
remainder.whyCode: palette-dependent branch with a fixed fallback

remainder.what: headline() hook: wet-floor markup, headline cut into five horizontal slices with data-t pseudo content so the reflection carries no text nodes
remainder.whyCode: hook generates DOM; the slice offsets and opacity ramp are CSS vars but the structure is code

remainder.what: panels hooks emit real window chrome markup (title bar text plus caption-button SVG, explorer column header) for card, panel and list
remainder.whyCode: structural markup, not CSS generated content

remainder.what: Built screens bring a sky band and a bubble behind the app UI
remainder.whyCode: decorative art in product screens; conflicts with the 'app UI has no art' rule, flagged not corrected

styles.notes: Roughly 40% of the look is the procedural sky/water/orb scene and the wet-floor headline, which are not param-driven. The gel material itself (gradient + cap + caustic + rim + shadow) is highly regular and carries the kit. Header states export-safe (no mask-image, no backdrop-filter; glass is near-opaque fill) (js 31). The kit signature block (css 620-639) says 'No art'; the Built sky band at css 397-417 contradicts it.

styles.name: Gorpcore
styles.coreTrick: A fixed stone ground woven with a 5px ripstop line grid carries the client colours as dyed fabric colourways (primary = shell, secondary = second panel and contour tint), while hardware metaphors (webbing, buckles, grommets, dashed stitching, a paper hang tag with a spec table) replace every control and a seeded marching-squares contour map is the hero art.
styles.colourRecipe: Primary is the shell fabric: client primary dyed 10% flatter (saturation x0.9, lightness unchanged) with a readable on-colour; used for the main action, the woven highlight label, the trail line and the selected toggle clip. A muted primary just gets flatter (no fallback; the rules say 'needs a real colourway'). Secondary = second colour-blocked panel, contour tint and lake. Accent = trail-blaze marker colour (accentInk). Fixed colours: stone #EDEBE6 (dark #1A1C1B), carbon #1B1D1C, blaze orange #FF5F1F (under ~3%, zip pull and position dot only), silver #C9CCCF, paper #F7F4EC. In the app kit the shell is simply the primary and blaze is spent on the selected-tab dot.

remainder.what: Seeded height field (hand-placed gaussian bumps, ridge and value noise) plus marching-squares contour extraction, segment chaining, index-contour label placement (rotated, knock-out stroke) and a summit search
remainder.whyCode: algorithmic generator; as a library it is one svg-generator primitive, but the bump table and ridge are bespoke

remainder.what: Map composition: hand-authored switchback trail points relative to the summit, lake path, 'you are here' dot, scale bar, coordinates, north arrow, cord path, carabiner, webbing loop; tag brand line fit (<=16 chars else shrink)
remainder.whyCode: bespoke art composition with hand-tuned coordinates

remainder.what: Elevation-profile progress bar: hand-drawn SVG silhouette as a data-URI background (light and dark versions) with an orange position dot at the fill end
remainder.whyCode: baked path data

remainder.what: App/kit rewrite: native-style segmented, toggle and progress replace the board hardware (webbing, buckle); grommets, stamps and spec text suppressed; section labels become stitched ink tape; badges get a punched hole
remainder.whyCode: per-selector adaptation of board components to the kit, i.e. two parallel recipes per component

remainder.what: Kit signature: field label as carbon tape folder tab, stencil face on the tape, slotted zip-pull slider, grommet radio
remainder.whyCode: multi-part hardware drawings built from gradients and pseudo-elements; css-recipe in principle, few reusable params

styles.notes: Heavy reliance on fixed (non-client) colours: only shell, shell2 and blaze-mark take client colour. Many moves here are visual metaphors (webbing, buckle, hang tag) that are one-off drawings with a handful of params, so they reuse poorly across other styles. The ripstop grid is explicitly absent on app screens (css 310-311).

notes: Group C audit (rev 1). All five styles read from their full js and css files, except: frutiger-aero.js lines 195-345 (faSky / faWater / faOrb / faScene SVG internals) and 353-445 were skimmed by function header and comment, not read line by line; per-style css kit blocks past the NN/g glossary section (data-pebble 310-463, dystopian 316-526 classic variant, frutiger 453-620, gorpcore 375-498) were skimmed by section comment, since they restate the same recipes per selector. dystopian-luxury.css also holds a '--classic' variant (from line 317), ignored per the brief. exportSafe flags are inferred from CSS features (mask-image, backdrop-filter, mix-blend-mode) and from the styles' own export comments (frutiger js 31, dystopian css 120); none were tested through the export path. Schema gaps: (1) the kit is selector-coupled: each style re-applies a handful of recipes to ~100 kit class selectors, and the schema has kitScope but no way to express a component-to-recipe map; moveCoverage therefore counts that mapping as 'move-carried' where the recipe is regular, but a framework needs a mapping table. (2) Moves such as hero-layout, named-states and voice-register are registry-hook settings rather than CSS; the schema has no category for hook fields. (3) frutiger Built screens carry a sky band and bubble (css 397-417), against the repo's 'app UI has no art' rule; recorded under remainder, not changed. Editorial exact values are in the editorial-serif notes.
